to reconcile with the MS evidence detailed earlier. It is always possible that S. drafted his curse
soon after 27 March 1817, as Mary remembered, and that the Nbk 15 draft represents a reworking
of it — though on examination it has the appearance of a first effort. Or perhaps an earlier draft
was lost and in Nbk 15 S. was rewriting it from memory. Or Mary may have recalled the time of
composition inaccurately. Whatever the case, the evidence of Nbk 15 makes very probable a date
between mid-July and 10 November 1820 for the draft of ‘To the C. —— ’ that occupies pp. 180–7.
